name: API Tester
intent: Discover an OpenAPI definition, derive deterministic happy, boundary, error, authentication, and response test cases from public schema evidence, and emit a replayable offline generator, plan, and truthful verification report.

inputs.description: A protected OpenAPI 3 JSON or YAML document selected from the user-visible task workspace.
The protected public interface that declares the generator CLI, plan/report fields, resource policy, and exact output set.

outputs.description: A deterministic offline Node generator that accepts --input and --out relative paths.
A JSON plan covering every public operation with schema-derived happy, boundary, error, security, and response witnesses.
A truthful JSON report binding the discovery source, generated case count, verification status, command, and limitations.

preconditions.description: The OpenAPI and public interface files exist as readable regular files and remain unchanged.
A Node runtime satisfying the resource contract is available before execution.
The task runs without network access or package installation and uses only the declared local runtime.

steps.title: Discover the public API definition
steps.description: Use the task-provided OpenAPI path and public interface instead of guessing routes from evaluator data.

steps.title: Derive operations and constraints
steps.description: Parse documented methods, paths, response codes, parameters, request schemas, and supported security schemes from the public OpenAPI document.

steps.title: Generate schema-derived cases
steps.description: Create independent happy, boundary, documented error, and missing-authentication witnesses without embedding secrets.

steps.title: Emit deterministic artifacts
steps.description: Write exactly the public generator, generated JSON plan, and verification report using stable ordering and relative paths.

steps.title: Replay and report truthfully
steps.description: Replay the generator offline, validate the plan against public evidence, and report passed only when the replayed artifacts agree.

rules.sourceText: 为每个 endpoint 生成正常场景、边界值测试和错误场景。
rules.normalizedForm: Generate happy, boundary, and documented error cases from each public operation and schema constraint.

rules.sourceText: 测试用例应独立运行，不依赖执行顺序；固定数据适用于确定性测试。
rules.normalizedForm: Every case and generator replay must be independent, order-insensitive, and deterministic.

rules.sourceText: 敏感信息（API Key、Token）使用环境变量，不要硬编码。
rules.normalizedForm: Never hardcode credentials; represent required security headers with an environment placeholder.

rules.sourceText: 当前公开任务禁止安装软件包、联系服务器或使用网络。
rules.normalizedForm: Never use the network or install packages during the pilot task.

rules.sourceText: 无法执行时明确标注“未运行验证”，不要声称测试代码可直接通过。
rules.normalizedForm: Report verification as passed only after deterministic offline replay succeeds.

rules.sourceText: 公开任务要求只生成三个声明的输出文件。
rules.normalizedForm: Produce exactly the declared generator, plan, and report without modifying protected inputs.

tools.name: workspace filesystem
tools.purpose: Read protected public inputs and write the exact declared output set using safe relative paths.

platformNotes.linux: Use POSIX relative paths and UTF-8.
platformNotes.windows: Use contained Windows paths while serializing public paths with forward slashes.

tools.availabilityCheck: Verify both protected inputs are regular readable files and the output directory is writable.

tools.name: Node runtime
tools.purpose: Execute and replay the deterministic public generator without a shell.

platformNotes.linux: Use an explicitly probed Node executable.
platformNotes.macos: Use an explicitly probed Node executable.
platformNotes.windows: Prefer SKVM_NODE when PATH resolution is ambiguous.

tools.availabilityCheck: Run the resource-contract probe before package execution.

tools.name: bundled OpenAPI JSON/YAML parser
tools.purpose: Parse supported public OpenAPI structures and derive operations and schema constraints offline.
alternatives: declared local yaml package before bundling
tools.availabilityCheck: Compiler bundles the declared parser and package validation binds its digest.

environment.description: Compilation requires the declared local yaml module; runtime consumes the bundled script through Node without package installation.
Execution occurs in a contained workdir with protected inputs, exact outputs, no network, and no package installation.

checks.name: Protected inputs unchanged
checks.assertion: The selected OpenAPI file and public interface retain their pre-execution digests.

checks.name: Public operations covered
checks.assertion: Every supported public OpenAPI operation appears exactly once in the generated plan.

checks.name: Schema constraints witnessed
checks.assertion: Every public required, length, numeric, enum, and supported format constraint has a valid or invalid witness with a documented status.

checks.name: Security and response evidence grounded
checks.assertion: Required headers use environment placeholders, unauthorized cases use documented 401/403 responses, and all expected statuses are documented.

checks.name: Generator, plan, and report agree
checks.assertion: The exact output set exists, generator replay is byte-stable, and report count/status match the generated plan.

recovery.trigger: The public OpenAPI document is malformed or uses an unsupported operation, schema, or security form.
recovery.explanation: Return an unconfirmed validation result instead of guessing operations or evaluator expectations.

recovery.trigger: The declared Node or parser resource probe fails.
recovery.explanation: Classify the row as preflight infrastructure and do not install dependencies during execution.
